from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
import json,hashlib,time,requests
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_bank_accepted_bill_discount_source_qualification_v1")
PROTO=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert not (OUT/"source_identity_and_download_route_receipts.json").exists()
assert json.loads((OUT/"historical_curve_sample_summary.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["additional_requests_used_total"]==8
assert 8+3<=PROTO["additional_official_requests_budget"]
def now(): return datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def save(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name
    assert not p.exists(),f"禁止覆盖：{p}"
    p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
original=json.loads((OUT/"historical_curve_sample_receipts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
corrected=[]
for receipt in original:
    value=receipt.get("returned_date")
    normalized=None
    if isinstance(value,str):
        for fmt in ("%Y.%m.%d","%Y-%m-%d"):
            try:
                normalized=datetime.strptime(value,fmt).date().isoformat(); break
            except ValueError: continue
    same=normalized==receipt["requested_date"]
    rows=receipt.get("six_month_rows") or []
    valid=receipt.get("response_code")=="000" and same and len(rows)==1
    corrected.append({"requested_date":receipt["requested_date"],"original_returned_date":value,
        "normalized_returned_date":normalized,"exact_same_calendar_date":same,
        "six_month_sample_located":valid,"six_month_rows":rows,
        "original_receipt_path":"historical_curve_sample_receipts.json",
        "historical_publication_time_established":False})
save("历史样例日期格式识别修正.json",{
    "saved_at":now(),"correction":"仅解析点号与连字符两种同日格式；原响应、日期和经济值不变，不覆盖原识别记录",
    "before_equity_labels_or_models":True,"samples":corrected,
    "accepted_same_date_6M_samples":sum(x["six_month_sample_located"] for x in corrected),
    "continuous_coverage_established":False,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0
})
market=BeautifulSoup((OUT/"sources/market.html").read_bytes(),"html.parser")
scripts={urljoin("http://www.shcpe.com.cn/content/shcpe/market.html",x["src"]) for x in market.find_all("script",src=True)}
download="http://www.shcpe.com.cn/etc/designs/shcpe/resource/themes/js/shcpe-download.js"
assert download in scripts
about=BeautifulSoup((OUT/"sources/about.html").read_bytes(),"html.parser")
assert about.find(attrs={"typecode":"about-introduction"}) is not None
start=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
common={"requestTime":start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),"requestSystem":"shcpe-cos","requestNo":int(time.time()*1000)}
jobs=[
    {"source_id":"official_regulator_home","method":"GET","url":"http://www.pbc.gov.cn/",
     "source_route":"已保存票交所首页友情链接"},
    {"source_id":"public_download_script","method":"GET","url":download,"source_route":"已保存市场页script.src"},
    {"source_id":"official_entity_article_list","method":"POST",
     "url":"http://www.shcpe.com.cn/shcpe-cos/article/list",
     "json":dict(common,pageSize=1,pageNum=1,typeCode="about-introduction"),
     "source_route":"已保存about.html类型及loadAboutList只读方法"}
]
save("05_主体互证与公开下载方法查询开始.json",{
    "started_at":now(),"prior_requests":8,"jobs":jobs,"remaining_after_batch":1,
    "new_equity_labels":0,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0
})
def request(job):
    receipt={**job,"requested_at":now(),"attempts":1}
    try:
        r=requests.request(job["method"],job["url"],json=job.get("json"),headers={
            "User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Referer":"http://www.shcpe.com.cn/content/shcpe/about.html",
            "Content-Type":"application/json;charset=UTF-8"
        },timeout=(10,25),stream=True)
        chunks=[]; size=0
        for chunk in r.iter_content(65536):
            size+=len(chunk)
            if size>1048576: raise ValueError("本固定说明页响应超过1MiB预算")
            chunks.append(chunk)
        raw=b"".join(chunks)
        suffix=".js" if job["source_id"]=="public_download_script" else ".bin"
        path=OUT/"sources"/(job["source_id"]+suffix)
        assert not path.exists(); path.write_bytes(raw)
        receipt.update({"status_code":r.status_code,"final_url":r.url,"content_type":r.headers.get("Content-Type"),
            "path":str(path).replace("\\","/"),"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            "successfully_received":True})
        r.close()
        if job["source_id"]=="official_entity_article_list":
            body=json.loads(raw)
            receipt["response_code"]=body.get("code")
            receipt["response_message"]=body.get("msg",body.get("message"))
            receipt["article_data"]=body.get("data")
        elif job["source_id"]=="official_regulator_home":
            soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,"html.parser")
            receipt["title"]=soup.title.get_text(" ",strip=True) if soup.title else None
            links=[]
            for a in soup.find_all("a",href=True):
                url=urljoin(receipt["final_url"],a["href"])
                if "票据" in a.get_text(" ",strip=True) or "shcpe" in url.lower():
                    links.append({"title":a.get_text(" ",strip=True),"url":url})
            receipt["bill_exchange_related_links"]=links
            receipt["regulator_explicit_cn_link"]=any(urlparse(x["url"]).hostname in ("www.shcpe.com.cn","shcpe.com.cn") for x in links)
    except Exception as error:
        receipt.update({"successfully_received":False,"error_type":type(error).__name__,"error":str(error)})
    receipt["completed_at"]=now()
    return receipt
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool: receipts=list(pool.map(request,jobs))
save("source_identity_and_download_route_receipts.json",receipts)
save("source_request_budget_after_identity.json",{
    "additional_requests_used":11,"additional_requests_remaining":1,
    "official_catalog_queries_used":4,"official_catalog_queries_remaining":0,
    "no_extra_requests_or_retries":True,"completed_at":now()
})
for x in receipts:
